propositions: Tool-call loops in the completion gate's verify step exhaust the step budget, leaving a bare LLMError with null diagnostic instead of a verdict
The tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors because toolConfig cannot be defined mid-run after tool use blocks have occurred
The existing repetition metric is inverted on real traces and cannot distinguish k-cycles from healthy breadth; a windowed distinct-ratio (window 24, trip ≤0.50) is needed to detect runaway loops
Runaway loops must be detected DURING the run and routed through bounded recovery with fresh per-criterion evidence, rather than surfaced as null-diagnostic failures
Every budget exhaustion or runaway must leave an operator-actionable gate_error_v1 diagnostic carrying repetition counters to distinguish looping from budget depletion
